preregistered.interpretation: reproduction of each served mesh's analyzer response at a repeated compilation seed

compilation_seeds.rule: nonzero draw values in index order, repeats skipped, at the positions off the stride

compilation_order.rule: anchors stay at every eighth position; the k-th off-stride position takes the perturbed mesh of the k-th smallest draw value, ties by index
